product_summary: Signal Board is a polished, responsive single-page decision board designed for small teams to collaboratively evaluate options. Users can add options, assign scores from 1 to 5, instantly view the leading option with deterministic tie-breaking, and manage the board state with local persistence and safe clearing mechanisms.
architecture_decision: The application will be built as a clean, modular client-side application using index.html, styles.css, and app.js. State management will reside in a single JavaScript object that synchronizes with localStorage. The UI will use semantic HTML and CSS custom properties to ensure a presentation-ready, responsive, and keyboard-accessible experience without external dependencies.

quests.objective: Establish the core HTML structure, responsive CSS layout, and the ability to add named options to the board.
acceptance_criteria: The layout includes a header, an option creation form, and an options list container.
Users can add new named options using a text input and a submit button.
Added options are rendered as distinct cards or rows in the UI.
The layout is fully responsive and adapts gracefully to mobile and desktop viewports.
No console errors occur when adding options.
evidence_required: An index.html file containing semantic markup for the board.
A styles.css file with responsive layout rules (Flexbox/Grid).
An app.js file implementing the option addition logic and rendering.

quests.objective: Implement the 1-to-5 scoring controls for each option and calculate the current leader with deterministic tie-breaking.
acceptance_criteria: Each option card displays interactive 1-to-5 scoring controls (e.g., radio buttons or buttons).
Changing a score immediately updates that option's value in the application state.
A prominent 'Leader' section displays the option with the highest score.
If there is a tie, the leader is determined deterministically (e.g., alphabetically or by creation order).
The leader display updates instantly whenever any score changes.
evidence_required: Updated app.js containing the scoring event handlers and leader calculation logic.
Updated index.html and styles.css displaying the leader section and interactive scoring controls.

quests.objective: Integrate localStorage persistence, keyboard accessibility, and a safe board clearing mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: All options and their scores are saved to localStorage on any change and restored on page reload.
A 'Clear Board' button is available, which prompts the user for confirmation before wiping the state.
When cleared, the board returns to an informative empty state.
All interactive elements (inputs, buttons, scoring controls) are fully keyboard-navigable and focus-visible.
A journey.json file is provided to document the primary user flow, and a README.md explains the application setup.
evidence_required: Updated app.js with localStorage synchronization and confirmation dialog logic.
Updated styles.css with focus indicators and keyboard-friendly styling.
A completed journey.json file mapping the user interactions.
A README.md file detailing the project structure and usage.
